title: Website Recovery Agent
description: Finds what is weak in a local-business website, then builds a better version.
problem: A local business can have a clear strength and still have little useful presence online.
build: An audit and positioning workflow that leads to a website direction. Designer Dental is one of five clinic previews, with the practice, doctor, services and consultation route brought into focus.

primaryVisual.alt: Designer Dental website preview: Dental brilliance, made gentle, with Dr. Kaynat Gilani and consultation links.

caption: Designer Dental / Khar West
note: One of five clinic website directions.
disclosure: Website direction, not a before-and-after claim.

title: Google Reputation Engine
description: Turns public review data into a clear reputation gap and action plan.
problem: Similar star ratings can hide a very different scale of public review evidence.
build: A public-data comparison that makes the reputation gap legible before deciding what to work on next. This supplied audit compares The Dandelion Dental Experience with Ceramco Dental.

primaryVisual.alt: Audit comparing Dandelion Dental and Ceramco Dental: both rated 4.9, with 139 and 1,691 reviews respectively, based on public data checked 28 July 2026.

caption: Public-data audit / 28 July 2026
note: Same rating. A different review base.
disclosure: An archived public-data snapshot. Figures are not a live feed or a claim of results delivered.

title: Missed Enquiry Recovery
description: Finds patient enquiries that went quiet before they became appointments.
problem: An enquiry can disappear between the first reply and an appointment.
build: A lightweight 7-day enquiry tracker built for VIBGYOR Pediatric & Family Dental Care, Borivali West. Today, follow-ups and the report sit alongside no-show recovery, recalls and manual reply drafts.

primaryVisual.title: VIBGYOR enquiry tracker: interactive prototype using fictional sample data

caption: VIBGYOR / Borivali West
disclosure: Fictional sample data. Changes reset on reload. No medical records. Nothing is sent.

title: BCCL Brand Voice Agent
description: Drafts inside a locked brand voice, then lets a human choose, reject and redirect.
problem: A draft can sound plausible and still miss the brand's voice or the editor's judgement.
build: A work sample that carries public voice constraints through options, selection, feedback and revision. The captured case-study run makes the prior and revised copy visible together; the public demo uses an offline generator.

primaryVisual.alt: BCCL work-sample case study showing human choice and feedback, then prior and revised copy side by side.

caption: Captured case-study run / Offline generator
disclosure: Work sample. Not affiliated with BCCL / Times of India. Public voice constraints, not an internal brand book.

title: Content Supply Chain Console
description: One brief, multiple formats, human gates, localisation and approval.
problem: Moving one idea across formats and markets creates more decisions than a single prompt can hold.
build: A console that carries a locked brand and master brief through social, video and email options, human selection, feedback and market versions. The public demo uses an offline generator and a fictional sample brand.

primaryVisual.alt: Content Supply Chain Console at Localize and approve, showing India English and UK English versions of social, video and email outputs.

caption: Localisation stage / Offline generator
note: One master. Two market voices. A human gate.
disclosure: Work sample / speculative demo. Not affiliated with Accenture and not an Accenture commission.
